title: Ollabench: Evaluating LLMs’ Reasoning for Human-centric Interdependent Cybersecurity
reasoning: OllaBench includes 'Moral' as one of the 24 cognitive behavioral constructs in its knowledge graph (Cybonto-4-IC). The benchmark evaluates the LLM's ability to reason about these constructs, effectively testing its ability to map behavioral descriptions to moral and ethical behavioral categories within a cybersecurity context.
